t: PCL BG5002 conical nozzle air blowgun is designed for efficient cleaning and debris removal using compressed air. Ideal for workshops, garages, and industrial settings, this air blowgun is a core tool for clearing dust and debris. Manufactured from chemical and impact-resistant acetal resin, it offers durability in demanding environments. A valve allows trigger-adjustable airflow, providing precise control for various tasks. An ergonomic handle ensures comfort during prolonged use. Equipped with a 110mm conical nozzle and to deliver a focused air stream, and a 270Ltr/min flow rate. Connects via a 1/4" BSP inlet.
b: 110mm Conical Nozzle For Focused Air Delivery
